title: 第七章 三个人两张床第八章 嫌弃
lines: 这一行不速之客来也匆匆，去也匆匆，却给张家留下了一个千金大小姐。
而当张寿无可奈何地打算带着朱大小姐参观自家在村里首屈一指的“豪宅”时，他突然想到了一个非常紧迫的问题：“这里距离京城多远？”
朱莹东张张西望望，正在心想爹不是嫌贫爱富的人，为什么会把她的“未婚夫”安置在这？闻听此言，她少不得认真算了一算：“有个几十里吧。回城时他们应该会加快速度，否则傍晚京城的城门要关了。”
“这么说，你要的两个丫头，今天来不及送来了？”张寿眼神微妙地看着面前犹未理解的千金大小姐，叹了一口气道，“我这家里没丫头，大小姐你真的行吗？”
朱莹没想到张寿关注的竟是这样一个问题，只觉得自己被看扁了，一时有些着恼：“我有手有脚，当然行！”
张寿不得不对她的死鸭子嘴硬表示怀疑。名门大小姐真的会自力更生？
不会穿衣服，吴氏能帮忙；不会梳头洗脸，吴氏也能帮忙；可如果是不会洗脚洗澡，难不成还要他老娘去伺候？这不是家里来了个未婚妻，简直是来了个太上皇啊！
朱莹见张寿没吭声，立时昂首挺胸道：“从小到大，就没有什么是我不会做的！”
眼见这犹如金童玉女……不，应该说玉童金女的两人竟然在斗嘴，吴氏起头一直紧绷的脸上，终于也能看见一丝笑容。然而，她仍然不知道该怎么和出身赵国公府的朱大小姐相处，此时索性悄然离开，叫了厨房的刘婶一块去内院整理屋子。
虽说心里犯嘀咕，张寿到底没有再去撩拨大小姐的虎须，带人里里外外逛了一圈自己的家。内外两进院子，外院东西厢房分别是老刘头和刘婶两夫妻外加阿六住，厅堂晚间就落锁关门，张寿病愈后这三年独住内院正房，而吴氏住在内院东厢，西厢房则是空着。
因为统共就这么大一点地方，逛一圈也不过一小会。不出意料，他听到了大小姐讶异的叹气声：“怎么这么小……”
张寿不禁呵呵：“家中简陋，大小姐你多包涵。毕竟，比起那些辛苦耕种的乡民来说，我这家里已经是豪奢了。”
见朱莹顿时默然，他便又添了一句：“当然，能住这房子，也要托令尊的福。”
朱莹有些不高兴：“你是不是打算和当初讽刺朱公权那样，也背上两首诗，嘲讽我不知民间疾苦？”
张寿不禁耸了耸肩：“由俭入奢易，由奢入俭难，这是人之常情，你家富贵也是你爹拿身家性命拼来的，我干嘛嘲讽你？不过，你家丫头不来也就罢了，可你的衣裳怎么办？”
如果说丫头问题，朱大小姐还自信自己能够克服，那么，此时听到这么一个没法妥协的重大问题，她顿时有些呆滞。
一天不换衣服这种事，平民百姓根本就无所谓，但对于她来说，那绝对是不能想象的！
要知道，她一天在家里有时候要换个好几套衣裳！骑马有骑马装，出门做客有专门的行头，进宫时还要再换，居家有家居常服，就连在后花园喂个雀儿，划个船，那也都得换！
最让她暗自恼火的是，张寿不但不想解决办法，还在那雪上加霜，落井下石。
“而且，我家不穿丝衣，都是布衣，大小姐你恐怕穿不惯。再说，你身材高挑，我娘比你矮，她的衣裳你也穿不上。不如我让老刘头和阿六套车，送你去追你家里那些人吧！”
“张寿，你就这么急着赶我走吗？”朱莹此时终于炸了。
我留下还不是为了帮你！一直留在这乡野之地，你岂不是要被朱公权那样的家伙看扁！为了想这么个留下的借口，我容易吗？
当然，若你相貌丰神俊朗，却是那种一见我或是知道我出身赵国公府就阿谀奉承的俗人，我也不会留下来……
吴氏正好从正房匆匆出来。恰巧听见张寿和朱莹似乎在大声说话，尤其是看到朱莹那委屈的样子，还以为两人在争吵，等上前问明白，她才笑了。
“阿寿之前新做了两套夏衣，都是丝绢的，是我为了他生辰特意准备的，我还没来得及告诉他，自然还没上身。你们身材相仿，大小姐你姑且穿着，想来赵国公府那边，明日一定就会把你那些行头都送来了。”
张寿好容易才酝酿出这么一种大小姐呆不下去的氛围，却被吴氏破坏得干干净净，顿时差点没绝倒。
朱莹却喜出望外。就单凭吴氏一句话噎得张寿无话可说，她终于可以放心留下，那也得感谢人家！虽说朱公权对吴氏那称呼在她脑海中转了转，但她须臾就将其按了下去。
眼珠子一转，她便笑道：“好，就听吴姨的！对了，我都住在你们家了，就别叫什么大小姐了，祖母和爹都叫我莹莹！”
之前被朱公权一句你不是正经婆婆狠狠一刺，吴氏到现在还觉得心里难受，此时听这位起头自己还觉得刁蛮任性的大小姐这么说，她一时又惊又喜，才刚说了一句那怎么使得，就见朱莹不大高兴似的，当下便立时知机地改口。
她灵机一动，指着笑眯眯的张寿道：“那莹莹你也和我一样，叫他阿寿吧！”
朱莹见张寿立刻苦了个脸，她明明喜出望外，却还得装着若无其事：“那我就随吴姨，叫他阿寿！”
之前没觉得，现在这样一叫，她着实觉得，这名字挺俗气的。就好像是高门大户担心孩子早夭，故意起的小名……
见大小姐笑眯眯连叫了两声阿寿，张寿顿时好生无奈。可是亲娘拖后腿，他有什么办法？
然而，他更没想到的是，吴氏突然又来了另一个让他大吃一惊的提议：“阿寿，晚上你和娘一块睡吧。”
“绝对不行！”张寿不假思索地反对。
见朱莹满面惊疑，吴氏不禁有些不好意思地解释道：“家里空屋子倒是有，从前阿寿睡在后院正房，我睡在东厢房，西厢房也空着，可如今把正房腾出来却也容易，但家里从来都没客人，合适的大床只有两张。前院倒是有两张床……但搬过来待客的话太怠慢了。”
张寿瞅了一眼朱莹，见美艳大小姐显然一副惊掉下巴的样子，他不禁摇头叹气。
你自己要赖在我家，现在看到乡下的条件艰苦了吧？
然而，他不可能完全把自己当成吴氏的亲儿子，哪能和她同床？
想到这里，知道撵走朱莹现在已经不大可能，他急中生智，放缓和语气对吴氏说：“娘，她初来乍到又是陌生环境，咱们家还没有丫头伺候，她肯定不习惯。不如娘你带她睡正房，有事也能有个照应。”
“至于我，一个人睡东厢就行了！大小姐你别忙着拒绝，乡下不比城里，没人打更，半夜三更风呜呜乱叫，和鬼哭狼嚎似的，指不定还会跑出野猪恶狼之类的猛兽来。”
听到这里，朱莹差点没起退堂鼓。可发现张寿仍然不肯叫自己的名字，想想自己掷地有声号称要留下，她就觉得打道回府实在太丢脸，当下便硬着头皮哼了一声。
“不用你吓我，既然床不够，我和吴姨一块睡就行了！我箭术好得很，要是真有这些神神鬼鬼的东西，我一箭就射跑了，这村里没人打得过我！”
content_en:
This uninvited guest came and went in a hurry, but left the Zhang family with a rich young lady.
And when Zhang Shou had no choice but to take Miss Zhu to visit his family's premier "mansion" in the village, he suddenly thought of a very urgent question: "How far is it from the capital?"
Zhu Ying looked around, thinking that her father was not someone who disliked poverty and loved wealth, so why would he place her "fiancé" here? After hearing this, she had to do some serious calculations: "It must be dozens of miles away. They should speed up when they return to the city, otherwise the gates of the capital will be closed in the evening."
"So, it's too late to deliver the two girls you want today?" Zhang Shou looked at the daughter-in-law who still didn't understand with subtle eyes, and sighed, "I don't have girls at home, can you really do it, Miss?"
Zhu Ying didn't expect that Zhang Shou was paying attention to such an issue. She just felt that she was looked down upon and was a little annoyed for a moment: "I have hands and feet, of course I can do it!"
Zhang Shou had to express doubts about her stubbornness. Can a famous lady really be self-reliant?
If he doesn’t know how to dress, Wu can help him; if he doesn’t know how to comb his hair and wash his face, Wu can also help him; but if he doesn’t know how to wash his feet and bathe, is it possible that he still needs his mother to take care of him? This is not just a fiancée coming to the house, but a king!
When Zhu Ying saw that Zhang Shou remained silent, she immediately held her head high and said, "Since I was a child, there is nothing I can't do!"
Seeing that the two people, who were like golden boys and jade girls... no, it should be said that they were bickering, finally a smile could be seen on Wu's face, which had been tense at first. However, she still didn't know how to get along with Miss Zhu, who was born in Duke Zhao's palace. At this time, she simply left quietly and asked Aunt Liu from the kitchen to go to the inner courtyard to tidy up the house.
Although he was murmuring in his heart, Zhang Shou did not try to tease the eldest lady's tiger beard anymore, and took the people around his home. There are two entrances to the courtyard. The east and west wings of the outer courtyard are occupied by the old couple Liu Tou and Aunt Liu plus Ah Liu. The hall is locked and closed at night. Zhang Shou lived alone in the main room of the inner courtyard for the past three years after recovering from illness. While Wu lived in the east wing of the inner courtyard, the west wing was empty.
Because it is such a big place in total, it only takes a short time to walk around. As expected, he heard the eldest lady sigh in surprise: "Why are you so young..."
Zhang Shou couldn't help but chuckle: "My home is simple, please bear with me, Miss. After all, compared to those villagers who work hard to farm, my home is already luxurious."
Seeing that Zhu Ying was silent for a moment, he added: "Of course, it is thanks to your father-in-law that I can live in this house."
Zhu Ying was a little unhappy: "Are you planning to memorize two poems just like you did when you satirized Zhu Gongquan, mocking me for not knowing the sufferings of the people?"
Zhang Shou couldn't help but shrugged: "It's easy to go from frugality to luxury, but it's hard to go from luxury to frugality. This is human nature. Your father risked his life and fortune to get your family's wealth. Why should I mock you? But it's fine if your girl doesn't come, but what about your clothes?"
If Miss Zhu was still confident that she could overcome the girl problem, then when she heard such a major issue that she could not compromise on, she suddenly felt a little sluggish.
Common people don't care about not changing clothes for a day, but for her, that is absolutely unimaginable!
You know, she sometimes has to change several sets of clothes a day at home! You have riding attire when you ride a horse, you have special outfits when you go out as a guest, you have to change when you enter the palace, you have daily clothes at home, even when you feed a sparrow in the back garden or row a boat, you have to change them!
What made her secretly annoyed the most was that Zhang Shou not only didn't want to solve the problem, but also made it worse and worse.
"Besides, my family doesn't wear silk clothes, they only wear cloth clothes. I'm afraid you won't be able to get used to wearing them, eldest lady. Besides, you are tall and my mother is shorter than you, so you can't wear her clothes. Why don't I let Old Liu Tou and Ah Liu set up a car and send you to chase those people in your family!"
"Zhang Shou, are you so anxious to drive me away?" Zhu Ying finally exploded at this time.
I'm not staying here just to help you! If you stay in this rural place, won't you be looked down upon by guys like Zhu Gongquan? Is it easy for me to come up with such an excuse to stay?
Of course, if you are good-looking and handsome, but are the kind of layman who flatters you as soon as you see me or know that I am from Duke Zhao's palace, I will not stay...
Mrs. Wu happened to come out of the main room in a hurry. She happened to hear Zhang Shou and Zhu Ying talking loudly. Especially when she saw Zhu Ying's aggrieved look, she thought they were quarreling. She only laughed when she stepped forward to ask.
"Ah Shou made two new sets of summer clothes before, both of which are made of silk. I specially prepared them for his birthday. I haven't had time to tell him yet, so naturally I haven't put on my clothes yet. You are of similar stature, so Miss, please wear them for now. If you want to come to Duke Zhao's Mansion, I will certainly send you all your outfits tomorrow."
Zhang Shou managed to create such an atmosphere that the eldest lady couldn't stay, but it was completely destroyed by Wu, and he almost collapsed immediately.
Zhu Ying was overjoyed. Wu's words alone made Zhang Shou speechless. She could finally stay with confidence, and that was all thanks to him! Although Zhu Gongquan's name for Wu swirled in her mind, she pressed it down in a moment.
As soon as she rolled her eyes, she smiled and said, "Okay, just listen to Aunt Wu! By the way, I'm already living in your house, so don't call me eldest lady. Grandma and dad both call me Yingying!"
Wu was stabbed hard by Zhu Gongquan when he said, "You are not a serious mother-in-law." Wu still felt uncomfortable in her heart. Now when she heard what the young lady, who at first she thought was unruly and willful, said, she was surprised and happy for a moment. Just after she said, "Why don't you do that," she saw that Zhu Ying was not very happy, so she immediately changed her words.
She had an idea, pointed at the smiling Zhang Shou and said, "Then Yingying, do the same as me, call him Ah Shou!"
Zhu Ying immediately grimaced when she saw Zhang Shou. She was obviously overjoyed, but she still had to pretend as if nothing had happened: "Then I will follow Aunt Wu and call him Ah Shou!"
She hadn't thought of it before, but now that she was called it like this, she really felt that the name was quite tacky. It's like a nickname deliberately given by a wealthy family who was worried that their children would die young...
Seeing the eldest lady smiling and calling "Shou" twice, Zhang Shou suddenly felt helpless. But his mother is holding him back, what can he do?
However, what he didn't expect was that Wu suddenly made another suggestion that surprised him: "Ah Shou, you and mother can sleep together tonight."
"Absolutely not!" Zhang Shou objected without hesitation.
Seeing the surprise on Zhu Ying's face, Mrs. Wu couldn't help but explain with some embarrassment: "There is an empty room in the house. In the past, Shou slept in the main room in the backyard, and I slept in the east wing. The west wing is also empty, but now it is easy to vacate the main room, but there are never any guests in the house, and there are only two suitable big beds. There are two beds in the front yard... But it would be too lazy to move them here to entertain guests."
Zhang Shou glanced at Zhu Ying and saw that the beautiful lady's jaw dropped. He couldn't help shaking his head and sighing.
You have to rely on my family. Now you see that the conditions in the countryside are difficult, right?
However, he couldn't completely regard himself as Wu's biological son, so how could he sleep with her?
Thinking of this and knowing that it was now impossible to drive Zhu Ying away, he was anxious and said to Wu in a calm tone: "Mom, she is new here and in a strange environment. We don't have a girl to take care of her yet. She must not be used to it. Why don't you take her to sleep in the main room, so that she can be taken care of if anything happens."
"As for me, I'll just sleep in the east wing alone! Miss, don't be too busy to refuse. The countryside is no better than the city. There is no one to watch the clock, and the wind howls in the middle of the night, just like the howling of ghosts and wolves. There may even be wild boars and wolves coming out."
Hearing this, Zhu Ying almost backed down. But she found that Zhang Shou still refused to call her by her name. Thinking about how loudly she said that she wanted to stay, she felt that it was too embarrassing to go back home, so she bit the bullet and snorted.
"You don't need to scare me. Since there aren't enough beds, I can just sleep with Aunt Wu! My archery skills are very good. If there really are these mysterious things, I can shoot them away with one arrow. No one in this village can beat me!"
title_en: Chapter 7: Three People and Two Beds Chapter 8: Dislike
